marks.title: Pulled gait
marks.text: She hangs from her pole tips, narrow, trailing a little behind them. The tips pull her along the wire; she makes no lift.

marks.title: She sees it
marks.text: A trolleybus on her pair of wires. No wind-up this time and no flare, and she will not pull her poles in.

marks.title: Tips brake
marks.text: Her tips brake hard along the wire and nothing else happens: her body keeps going, swings forward under them and starts up the front.

marks.title: Release at 60°
marks.text: Both tips open. On full-length poles she leaves from well below the wires, so she lets go further behind the bus than in the other versions.

marks.title: Up between the wires
marks.text: She rises through the wire plane just behind the trolleybus's collector shoes, narrow, touching neither wire.

marks.title: Apex, stretched
marks.text: No hoop. The backward turn the swing gave her is all she needs: 1.5 turns in the air, stretched out, brings her poles round from up and back to down and forward.

marks.title: The catch
marks.text: One tip per wire, landing already running at her speed. She has less speed than she started with, so there is nothing to shed and no circle.

marks.title: Swinging under
marks.text: She falls behind and under her tips while they settle to cruise speed; the tips follow her swing to calm it.

marks.title: Pulled gait again
marks.text: Cruise speed, hanging a little behind her tips, the trolleybus behind her.
